evidencePolicy: Only the frozen screenshot-first observed claims, source observation manifest, rendered asset inventory and action evidence named by interpreter-1 are authoritative. Asset sourceSha256 values are canonical source-URL identity hashes, not payload hashes. Dembrandt output, CSS names and aggregate palettes are candidates only.

patterns.observedFact: At 1440x900, #index fills the viewport with moving hero media, fixed navigation and a lower download/action cluster.
patterns.interpretation: Home identity depends on a moving environmental field with independent navigation and action layers, rather than a poster or color-only treatment.
patterns.recommendation: Preserve the dominant moving field and independently positioned navigation and download cluster.
allowedTransformations: responsive reflow preserving visual mass and action hierarchy
DOM/CSS reconstruction with independent runtime assets

patterns.observedFact: At 1440x900, #gameplay combines a wide media slab, edge arrows and a vertical 01/05-05/05 timeline over a dedicated backdrop.
patterns.interpretation: Gameplay communicates browsable modes through one dominant media plane plus sparse directional and numbered HUD controls.
patterns.recommendation: Keep the media slab dominant and retain both edge navigation and vertical progress structure.
allowedTransformations: replace media content while retaining slab role
vertical reflow that preserves media-control-timeline order

patterns.observedFact: At 1440x900, #character combines a moving character stage, portrait rail, layered identity/voice panel and angled skill cards.
patterns.interpretation: Character browsing is a synchronized asymmetric profile composition: selection, moving subject, narrative identity and abilities remain distinct layers.
patterns.recommendation: Preserve all four roles and the identity-description-voice-skills reading order.
allowedTransformations: replace character content while preserving role synchronization
responsive stack retaining reading order and angled skill treatment

patterns.scope: selected top navigation text on Home, Gameplay and Character settled states
patterns.observedFact: The selected top-navigation anchor computes to rgb(255, 85, 20) on all three required surfaces.
patterns.interpretation: Orange is a narrow current-location emphasis, not evidence for a global primary fill or every interactive state.
patterns.recommendation: Use orange for the current top-level navigation text only unless new rendered evidence validates another role.
allowedTransformations: contrast-preserving use on the same current-navigation text role

informationDensity.observedFact: Each required surface occupies one 1440x900 viewport. Home is sparse and scene-led with a lower action cluster; Gameplay concentrates one wide media slab plus edge arrows and a five-step vertical timeline; Character carries the densest layered profile with portrait rail, identity/voice information and angled skill cards.
informationDensity.interpretation: Density is surface-specific and hierarchical: sparse cinematic entry, medium-density mode browsing, then high-density character inspection.
informationDensity.recommendation: Do not normalize the three surfaces into a common card density; preserve each surface's dominant mass and supporting HUD density.
